arxiv-2010-15543.title: The group structure of elliptic curves over ℤ / N ​ ℤ \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}
arxiv-2010-15543.creator: Massimiliano Sala, Daniele Taufer
arxiv-2010-15543.description: Abstract We characterize the possible groups E ⁡ ( ℤ / N ​ ℤ ) E(\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}) arising from elliptic curves over ℤ / N ​ ℤ \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z} in terms of the groups E ⁡ ( 𝔽 p ) E(\mathbb{F}_{p}) , with p p varying among the prime divisors of N N .

arxiv-2011-04777.title: Summations by parton showers of large logarithms in electron-positron annihilation Preprint: DESY 20-182
arxiv-2011-04777.creator: Zoltán Nagy, Davison E. Soper
arxiv-2011-04777.description: Abstract In a companion publication, we have explored how to examine the summation of large logarithms in a parton shower. Here, we apply this general program to the thrust distribution in electron-positron annihilation, using several shower algorithms. The method is to work with an appropriate integral transform of the distribution for the observable of interest.

arxiv-2205-00130.title: ExSum : From Local Explanations to Model Understanding
arxiv-2205-00130.creator: Yilun Zhou, Marco Tulio Ribeiro, Julie Shah
arxiv-2205-00130.description: Abstract Interpretability methods are developed to understand the working mechanisms of black-box models, which is crucial to their responsible deployment. Fulfilling this goal requires both that the explanations generated by these methods are correct and that people can easily and reliably understand them.

arxiv-2301-01662.title: Unimodular approaches to the cosmological constant problem
arxiv-2301-01662.creator: Pavel Jiroušek *
arxiv-2301-01662.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pavel Jiroušek *. We review selected aspects of unimodular gravity and we discuss its viability as a solution of the old cosmological constant problem. In unimodular gravity the cosmological constant is promoted to a global degree of freedom. We highlight the importance of correctly setting up its initial data in order to achieve a resolution of the cosmological constant problem on a semi-classical level.

arxiv-2306-07788.title: Quantum Entanglement in Top Quark Pair Production
arxiv-2306-07788.creator: Mira Varma, Oliver K. Baker
arxiv-2306-07788.description: Abstract Top quarks, the most massive particles in the standard model, attract considerable attention since they decay before hadronizing. This presents physicists with a unique opportunity to directly investigate their properties. In this letter, we expand upon the work of G. Iskander, J. Pan, M. Tyler, C. Weber and O. K.

arxiv-2310-11351.title: Entanglement phase transitions in non-Hermitian Floquet systems
arxiv-2310-11351.creator: Longwen Zhou
arxiv-2310-11351.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Longwen Zhou. The competition between unitary time-evolution and quantum measurements could induce phase transitions in the entanglement characteristics of quantum many-body dynamics. In this work, we reveal such entanglement transitions in the context of non-Hermitian Floquet systems. Focusing on noninteracting fermions in a representative bipartite lattice with balanced gain/loss and under time-periodic quenches, we uncover rich patterns of entanglement transitions due to the interplay between driving and non-Hermitian effects.

arxiv-2406-19371.title: Suri : Multi-constraint Instruction Following for Long-form Text Generation
arxiv-2406-19371.creator: Chau Minh Pham, Simeng Sun, Mohit Iyyer
arxiv-2406-19371.description: Abstract Existing research on instruction following largely focuses on tasks with simple instructions and short responses. In this work, we explore multi-constraint instruction following for generating long-form text. We create Suri , a dataset with 20K human-written long-form texts paired with LLM-generated backtranslated instructions that contain multiple complex constraints.

arxiv-2509-24382.title: REALIGN: Re gularized Procedure Align ment with Matching Video Embeddings via Partial Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport
arxiv-2509-24382.creator: Soumyadeep Chandra, Kaushik Roy
arxiv-2509-24382.description: Abstract Learning from procedural videos remains a core challenge in self-supervised representation learning, as real-world instructional data often contains background segments, repeated actions, and steps presented out of order. Such variability violates the strong monotonicity assumptions underlying many alignment methods.

arxiv-2511-03416.title: Robust Alignment of the Human Embryo in 3D Ultrasound using PCA and an Ensemble of Heuristic, Atlas-based and Learning-based Classifiers Evaluated on the Rotterdam Periconceptional Cohort
arxiv-2511-03416.creator: Nikolai Herrmann( n.herrmann@erasmusmc.nl ), Marcella C. Zijta, Stefan Klein, Régine P.M. Steegers-Theunissen, Rene M.H. Wijnen, Bernadette S. de Bakker, Melek Rousian, Wietske A.P. Bastiaansen
arxiv-2511-03416.description: Abstract Standardized alignment of the embryo in three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound images aids prenatal growth monitoring by facilitating standard plane detection, improving visualization of landmarks and accentuating differences between different scans. In this work, we propose an automated method for standardizing this alignment.

arxiv-2512-16435.title: Quantum-Inspired Ising Machines for Quantum Chemistry Calculations
arxiv-2512-16435.creator: Mahmood Hasani, Hadis Salasi, Negar Ashari Astani
arxiv-2512-16435.description: Abstract Four decades after Richard Feynman’s famous remark, we have reached a stage at which nature can be simulated quantum mechanically. Quantum simulation is among the most promising applications of quantum computing; however, like many quantum algorithms, it is severely constrained by noise in near-term hardware. Quantum-inspired algorithms provide an attractive alternative by avoiding the need for error-prone quantum devices.

In this study, based on 11 public datasets...

pmc-10525540.title: NRF2, a Superstar of Ferroptosis
pmc-10525540.creator: Ruihan Yan, Bingyi Lin, Wenwei Jin, Ling Tang, Shuming Hu, Rong Cai
pmc-10525540.description: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent and lipid peroxidation-driven cell death cascade, occurring when there is an imbalance of redox homeostasis in the cell. Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NFE2L2, also known as NRF2) is key for cellular antioxidant responses, which promotes downstream genes transcription by binding to their antioxidant response elements (AREs).

pmc-11283535.title: Peri active site catalysis of proline isomerisation is the molecular basis of allomorphy in β-phosphoglucomutase
pmc-11283535.creator: F Aaron Cruz-Navarrete, Nicola J Baxter, Adam J Flinders, Anamaria Buzoianu, Matthew J Cliff, Patrick J Baker, Jonathan P Waltho
pmc-11283535.description: Metabolic regulation occurs through precise control of enzyme activity. Allomorphy is a post-translational fine control mechanism where the catalytic rate is governed by a conformational switch that shifts the enzyme population between forms with different activities. β-Phosphoglucomutase (βPGM) uses allomorphy in the catalysis of isomerisation of β-glucose 1-phosphate to glucose 6-phosphate via β-glucose 1,6-bisphosphate.

pmc-11473772.title: Comprehensive risk factor-based nomogram for predicting one-year mortality in patients with sepsis-associated encephalopathy
pmc-11473772.creator: Guangyong Jin, Menglu Zhou, Jiayi Chen, Buqing Ma, Jianrong Wang, Rui Ye, Chunxiao Fang, Wei Hu, Yanan Dai
pmc-11473772.description: Sepsis-associated encephalopathy (SAE) is a frequent and severe complication in septic patients, characterized by diffuse brain dysfunction resulting from systemic inflammation. Accurate prediction of long-term mortality in these patients is critical for improving clinical outcomes and guiding treatment strategies. We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the MIMIC IV database to identify adult patients diagnosed with SAE.

pmc-11598365.title: Cell-Free Screening, Production and Animal Testing of a STI-Related Chlamydial Major Outer Membrane Protein Supported in Nanolipoproteins
pmc-11598365.creator: Mariam Mohagheghi, Abisola Abisoye-Ogunniyan, Angela C Evans, Alexander E Peterson, Gregory A Bude, Steven Hoang-Phou, Byron Dillon Vannest, Dominique Hall, Amy Rasley, Dina R Weilhammer, Nicholas O Fischer, Wei He, Beverly V Robinson, Sukumar Pal, Anatoli Slepenkin, Luis de la Maza, Matthew A Colem
pmc-11598365.description: Background: Vaccine development against Chlamydia, a prevalent sexually transmitted infection (STI), is imperative due to its global public health impact. However, significant challenges arise in the production of effective subunit vaccines based on recombinant protein antigens, particularly with membrane proteins like the Major Outer Membrane Protein (MOMP).

pmc-11692274.title: “I’M GOING TO LIVE HOW LONG?” EXPLORING GAPS AND INFLUENTIAL FACTORS IN PERCEPTIONS OF LIFE EXPECTANCY
pmc-11692274.creator: Lauren Cerino, Adam Felts, Lisa D’Ambrosio, Taylor Patskanick, Joseph Coughlin
pmc-11692274.description: As the population ages and life expectancy increases, it becomes increasingly important to understand the public’s perceptions and expectations of their own aging, longevity, and life expectancy. Research shows that most people tend to underestimate their own life expectancy (Bago d’Uva, O’Donnell, and van Doorslaer, 2017; Society of Actuaries, 2020).

pmc-12724235.title: Integrative Spatial Transcriptomics and Experimental Validation Reveal UBC-Mediated EMT Associated with Immune Evasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-12724235.creator: Xiaosong Li, Xian Qin, Kezhi Shi, Guangrui Lu, Guodong Tian, Yue Chen, Rucheng Yao
pmc-12724235.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) exhibits pronounced spatial heterogeneity that limits therapeutic efficacy. The contribution of epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT) to regional tumor progression and immune evasion remains incompletely understood.MethodsWe integrated bulk transcriptomic datasets (TCGA, GSE14520), 34 single-cell RNA-seq samples, and 15 spatial transcriptomic datasets to delineate EMT activity across distinct HCC regions.

pmc-12973804.title: Ultrasonic repression of TRPA1-dependent astrocyte reactivity confers neuroprotection in models of Lewy body dementia
pmc-12973804.creator: Ji Hun Kim, Keunhyung Lee, Minseok Koo, Doeun Kim, Jin Kyung Hong, Jeong-Yun Choi, Han Seok Ko, Joo-Ho Shin, Joo Min Park, Jinhyoung Park, Yunjong Lee
pmc-12973804.description: BackgroundThe pathology of Lewy body dementia (LBD) features neuronal α-synuclein (α-syn) accumulation and astrocytic hyperactivation in cognitive brain circuits. Ultra-low-intensity ultrasound (ULIUS) modulates astrocyte function via transient receptor potential ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) and has been investigated for therapeutic applications in neurodegenerative diseases.

pmc-13295170.title: Honeysuckle-derived nanovesicles alleviate inflammatory bowel disease-associated neuropsychiatric disorders via the gut–brain axis
pmc-13295170.creator: Ailin Wu, Qin Chu, Le Ding, Yan Zeng, Liqiang Shao, Yuanyuan Wang, Yuanhao Zhou, Weijiao Fan, Xin Zhang, Jianwei Wang, Jie Wang, Shunyuan Guo, Ketao Jin, Xiaoru Chang, Xiaozhou Mou

pmc-13661533.title: Machine learning in automatic detection of chordoma signature, postoperative residuals, and prognosis of skull base chordomas
pmc-13661533.creator: Daniela Stastna, Richard Mannion, Robert Macfarlane, Patrick Axon, Neil Donnelly, James R. Tysome, Daniele Borsetto, Ryan Chrenek, Kaasinath Balagurunath, Wenya Linda Bi, Carleton E. Corrales, Ossama Al-Mefty, Timothy Smith, Ari Ercole, Jonathan Coles
pmc-13661533.description: Skull base chordomas are rare, locally invasive tumors that remain a diagnostic and therapeutic challenge. We developed a machine-learning (ML) radiomics model to (i) distinguish chordoma from chondrosarcoma and skull base background, (ii) differentiate true postoperative residual tumor from treatment-related changes, and (iii) predict 2-year progression-free survival (PFS).
